messages:
mina (Partnerships): Quick thread: HeliosTech confirmed a co-hosted micro-session at CloudSummit. Need final speaker list, 10min demo slot plan, on-site swag handoff, and embargo window for blog post. tagging @yuri to confirm speakers.

dan (FieldEng): For demos, propose 1 live demo (6m) + 1 pre-recorded fallback (90s). We should reserve a staging API key and a local mock if network flaky.

yuri (HeliosTech): Wehave two presenters: me (cloud partnerships lead) + arin (senior infra). Arin can run the live demo; we can ship 1 devpod for stage.

hannah (Events): Room C tech: HDMI + livestream RTMP + 1 lav mic. Slides due 48h prior. Swag handoff point: Partner check-in desk behind Hall 3, opens 8:00am. Ship deadline to venue: Thu 5pm.

mina (Partnerships): Good. Who will draft the micro-announcement copy and loop legal for logos?

yuri (HeliosTech): I'll provide partner blurb and logo. ETA Tue noon.

dan (FieldEng): I'll create a smoke test script and the pre-record template. Quick curl test to run on-site:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://demo.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAGE_KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-lite","input":"cloudsummit test"}'
```

hannah (Events): AV asks presenters bring USB-C + HDMI adapters. Also recommend rehearsing 30min before.

mina (Partnerships): Action items:
- Mina: draft announcement + send to legal by Tue (ASSIGNED)
- Dan: smoke test + fallback video by Thu EOD (ASSIGNED)
- Yuri: speaker bios + ship devpod by Wed (PARTNER)
- Hannah: confirm AV + swag desk pickup times (ASSIGNED)

opsbot: Reminder set: "HeliosTech rehearsal" Wed 09:30am local (created by mina)

mina (Partnerships): Thanks all I'll post the announcement draft here when ready.
